newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Darya Varia sees poor H1 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Darya Varia sees poor H1 net profit.

text.p: Indonesian pharmaceutical firm PT Darya Varia Laboratoria said on Tuesday it saw a poor first half net profit and expected to revise down its 1997 full year net profit forecast.

"We expect to revise down our full year forecast as the first half results are likely to be poor due partly to a slowdown in demand because of the May general elections," corporate communications manager Suziana Prapti told Reuters.
She did not give any figures, adding that the revision was likely to be announced next month.
Shares of Darya Varia have come under strong selling pressure over the past several days due to market talk of expected poor first half results, brokers said.
Darya was unchanged at 2,100 rupiah in late morning trading on Tuesday.
It touched a year low of 1,925 rupiah on Monday compared with a year high of 4,500 rupiah in early January.
Prapti said the poor results were also due to acquisitions of several pharmaceutical firms by Darya last year and the resignations of two members of the company's top management early this year.
Prapti, however, said the firm has now recruited two directors to fill the positions and was making internal changes to improve performance.
Darya's previous 1997 full year net profit forecast was 28 billion rupiah, Prapti said.
Darya posted a net profit of 23.58 billion rupiah in 1996 against 15.86 billion rupiah in 1995.
Darya posted a net profit of 9.32 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1996 against 8.26 billion rupiah in the same period of 1995. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
